description: Read-only: diff the parameters of two nodes, returning only the values that differ (by default). Returns {type_match, differing_count, differing[], same_count}. Useful for aligning settings across similar operators; compares two live nodes, whereas diff_snapshots compares two whole-network snapshots over time.

only_diff.description: Return only the parameters that differ (true) or also list the identical ones.

name: compare_td_nodes

a.description: Path of the first node compared.

b.description: Path of the second node compared.

differing.description: Every parameter that differs, with each node's value.

a.description: Its value on the first node.

b.description: Its value on the second node.

differing_count.description: Number of parameters whose values differ.

identical.description: Names of identical parameters; present only when only_diff is false.

same_count.description: Number of parameters that are identical on both nodes.

type_a.description: Operator type of the first node.

type_b.description: Operator type of the second node.

type_match.description: True if both nodes are the same operator type.

title: Compare two nodes
